name: Midas mHYPER
oneLiner: mHYPER is a Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token wrapping Hyperithm market-neutral stablecoin strategies; permissioned mint/redeem, not a fixed $1 peg.
collateral: Hyperithm-managed market-neutral stablecoin strategies across on-chain markets and institutional execution venues, held under Fordefi MPC custody (manager holds the trading key share, Midas holds an admin/policy share). Tokenholders hold a qualified subordinated claim against Midas (no ownership of the underlying assets), secured by a Security Agent lien on the Collateral Account for tokenholders.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting tokenized debt instrument (blockchain-based certificate under German law), not a fixed $1 peg; value tracks the daily NAV of the Hyperithm-managed market-neutral reference portfolio. Primary mint/redeem only via permissioned Midas DepositVault/RedemptionVault for greenlisted users with NAV conversion settled off-chain by the issuer; instant redemptions are facilitated through Midas Staked Liquidity (MSL). No fixed $1 redemption floor.

proofOfReserves.provider: Midas Attestation Engine: on-chain NAV/proof-of-reserves/price, independently verified via Chainlink, Canary, LlamaRisk and vLayer (launched first on mHYPER)

jurisdiction.regulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority only; issuer not FMA-licensed)
jurisdiction.license: EU-Prospectus-Regulation-approved tokenized debt instrument (blockchain-based certificate under German law); EEA-restricted, not available to U.S. retail persons

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes: Midas mHYPER is a permissioned liquid-yield token with issuer/admin control surfaces around minting, redemption, transfer administration, and upgradeable protocol contracts.

reserveReview.rationale: The reserve label describes a managed market-neutral strategy and NAV, not a stablecoin reserve token.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No stablecoin-linked reserve slice remains unresolved.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The phrase describes the strategy mandate; it is not the identity of a tracked stablecoin claim.

mintAuthority.summary: mHYPER is minted exclusively by the MHyperDepositVault proxy (0xba9f…) holding M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE in the shared MidasAccessControl (0x0312…). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by a 1-of-3 Midas Safe and an EOA. Proxy upgrades require a 2-day MidasTimelockController. Remote-chain (Monad/Plasma/Katana) supply is bridged from Ethereum; bridge admin unverified on non-EVM chains.

controls.label: mHYPER MHyperDepositVault (M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295093, hasRole(M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE=keccak256('M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE'), 0xba9f…) returned true on MidasAccessControl 0x0312…. Implementation: MHyperDepositVault (0xd2B5…). This is the only address currently holding this role.

controls.label: Midas DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE Safe (1-of-3)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295093, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE=0x0000…, 0xb608…) returned true on MidasAccessControl. getOwners() = 3 signers; threshold = 1; 0 modules; guard = 0x0; Safe v1.4.1.

controls.label: Midas DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295093, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xd419…) returned true on MidasAccessControl. eth_getCode = 0x (EOA).

controls.label: MidasTimelockController (proxy upgrade guard)
controls.evidence: ProxyAdmin (0xbf25…) owner() = 0xe3ee… (MidasTimelockController). getMinDelay() = 172800 s (2 days). Proxy upgrades for all mToken and vault contracts require passing through this timelock.

review.evidence: All five Midas mTokens share MidasAccessControl at 0x0312a9d1ff2372ddedcbb21e4b6389afc919ac4b. At block 25295093: M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE held only by MHyperDepositVault proxy 0xba9f…; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by Safe 0xb608… (1-of-3, no modules) and EOA 0xd419…; shared ProxyAdmin 0xbf25… gated by 2-day MidasTimelockController 0xe3ee…. Remote-chain (Monad/Plasma/Katana) bridge admin not read — those deployments are bridged supply; the Ethereum issuance surface is the authoritative mint surface.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: mHYPER has reviewed cross-chain route evidence through Across, an intent/liquidity framework rather than issuer-native settlement. The route is scored as liquidity/intent because execution and available bridge liquidity are material to cross-chain movement.
